  │
  ├─ Success → run pytest

  │   └─ ALL PASS → invoke review agent (step-dispatch.md)
  │       ├─ Review PASS + Delta < 15 → update SOT, proceed
  │       ├─ Review PASS + Delta ≥ 15 → F-14 (adopt lower, flag)
  │       ├─ Review FAIL (critical) → F-1 (rework agent output)

  │   ├─ Replacement succeeds → proceed

```
